info.title: Khandani Rishta API
info.description: HTTP API used by the Khandani Rishta web and Android apps.

get.summary: The API process is running.
The API can reach the database and is ready for traffic.

post.summary:
Sends one notification to every active member (admin only). At most one per 24 hours; it
cannot be recalled. Answers `202`: the `announcement_fanout` job does the work.

get.summary: Audit entries, newest first.

parameters.name: actor_user_id
parameters.description: Only entries written by this staff user.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: An action code of 18 section 8.3, for example `user.ban`.

get.summary: Suggested castes, most used first, with similar existing castes.

post.summary: Promotes a suggestion to a caste (admin only) and rewrites the profiles that typed it.
Rejects a pending suggestion.

get.summary: Every caste and sub-caste, including inactive ones.

post.summary: Adds a caste or sub-caste (admin only).

patch.summary: Renames, re-orders, changes the aliases of, or (de)activates a caste (admin only).

get.summary: Queue sizes and headline numbers, cached in memory for 60 seconds.

The photo queue: photos the automatic check flagged first, then oldest first. Cursor
pagination.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
`pending_review` (default), `approved`, `rejected`, `processing` or `failed`. Photos
without processed files are never listed.

post.summary:
Approves a photo that is `pending_review` or `approved` (18 section 4.2). The profile's first
approved photo becomes its main photo; completeness and recommendations are refreshed; the
owner gets a `photo_approved` notification; `photo.approve` is audited. Answers `204`.

Rejects a photo that is `pending_review` or `approved`. A rejected main photo is replaced by
the next approved photo; the files are deleted after 30 days; the owner gets a
`photo_rejected` notification; `photo.reject` is audited. Answers `204`.

get.summary: The review queue and profile search, longest waiting first.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Any profile status. Without `q` the default is `pending_review`, the review queue.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A profile code, or the start of a first or last name.

get.summary:
One profile in full: private fields, history, reports, sanctions. Contact details are
included for admins only.

post.summary: `pending_review` to `active`.

patch.summary: Corrects name, gender or date of birth on the owner's behalf (admin only).

post.summary: `pending_review` to `changes_requested`.

get.summary: The release records, newest first.

post.summary:
Records a build that CI has already uploaded (admin only). Rows are never edited or deleted:
to correct a mistake, publish a new record.

get.summary: The report queue: by priority (13 section 6.5), then oldest first.
One report with its context, the target's history and related reports.

post.summary: `open` to `in_review`. `409` when someone else claimed it.

Decides a report. Allowed from `in_review`, and from `open` only as `dismissed` (bulk
dismissal of duplicates).

get.summary: Every setting of 03 section 7, whether or not a row exists yet.

put.summary:
Changes one setting (admin only): validates it, stores it, refreshes the settings cache at
once and, for a legal version, drops every account snapshot so members are asked to accept
the new document. An unknown key answers `404`.

get.summary:
Pending texts that no queued or running `moderate_text` job is about to decide, oldest
first. Cursor pagination.

post.summary:
Approves a pending text. No notification (18 section 4.3); `text.approve` is audited.
Answers `204`. `409 invalid_state` when the text changed or was decided already.

Rejects a pending text. The owner gets a `text_rejected` notification carrying the field and
the note; `text.reject` is audited. Answers `204`. `409 invalid_state` when the text changed
or was decided already.

get.summary:
Searches accounts. At least one of `q`, `status` and `role` is required: the console has no
"browse members" screen on purpose (18 section 10).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
At least 3 characters: an exact email, a phone number (7 or more digits, suffix match),
an exact profile code, or the start of a first or last name.

get.summary: One account: sanctions, devices, consents, reports and history.

post.summary:
Bans an `active` or `suspended` member (admin only): connections end and the identity
number, email and phone go on the block list.

patch.summary:
Changes a role (admin only). An admin cannot change their own role; the target must be
`active`.

post.summary: Suspends an `active` member for a number of days.
Lifts a ban (admin only).
Lifts a suspension.
Warns an `active` member: a notification and an email, no status change.

get.summary: The verification queue, oldest first. Cursor pagination.

A request with its images, the registered number and the profile to compare with. Every call
writes a `verification.view` audit row, also for requests already decided; the row and the
response stand or fall together. The response is not cacheable.

post.summary:
Approves a pending request (12 sections 4.5 and 5.4). An identity check verifies the number,
sets `is_id_verified` (which also locks the names) and, with `photos_match`, the photo badge;
a selfie sets `is_photo_verified` and needs an approved photo. The member gets a
`verification_approved` notification and email; `verification.approve` is audited. Answers
`204`; `409 invalid_state` unless the request is pending.

Rejects a pending request with a reason (12 sections 4.5 and 5.4). A rejected identity check
leaves the identity `rejected`; the member may submit again at once. The member gets a
`verification_rejected` notification and email with the reason (never the note);
`verification.reject` is audited. Answers `204`; `409 invalid_state` unless pending.

get.summary: Profiles the caller blocked, newest first. No photo and no other data.

put.summary:
Block a profile. In one transaction: the block, the active connection ended with reason
`blocked`, pending interests closed, photo access revoked both ways, shortlist entries and
recommendations deleted both ways, notifications about each other removed. The other
member is not told; each simply disappears for the other.

delete.summary: Remove a block. Nothing else is restored.

get.summary:
The chat list. `filter` is `active` (default, without archived chats), `archived` or
`ended`. Ordered by `last_message_at` descending; connections without messages by
`created_at`.
One connection of the caller.

patch.summary:
Mute or archive a chat. Both flags are the caller's own and invisible to the other member.
A muted chat sends no push and does not count in `counters.unread_chats`; an archived chat
moves to the Archived tab until the next message arrives.

put.summary: Share contact details with the other member, or change which items are shared.
put.description:
At least one item must be selected, and each selected item must have a value in the
caller's contact details (`validation_failed` with field code `required` on the share flag,
so the client can open the contact form). The share is a reference: later edits of the
details are what the other member sees. Posts a `contact_shared` system message and
notifies the other member.

post.summary: End the connection with a reason, and optionally block the other member.
post.description:
Both contact shares and the photo access between the pair are revoked, a pending stage
proposal is cancelled and a `connection_ended` system message is posted. The other member is
not notified and never sees the reason. Neither may send the other an interest for
`connection.cooldown_after_end_days` (90).

get.summary:
Message history: the newest `limit` (default 30, at most 100) messages newest first, or
those older than `before` (newest first), or those newer than `after` (oldest first; repeat
while `has_more`). Ended connections stay readable.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Messages older than this id, newest first.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Messages newer than this id, oldest first.

post.summary: Send a text message.
post.description:
`client_message_id` is a UUID made by the client and reused on every retry: sending it
again returns the original message with `200` and changes nothing. Errors:
`connection_ended`; `invalid_state` with `details.status = 'other_unavailable'` when the
other member can no longer be opened (suspended, banned, scheduled for deletion);
`rate_limited` (`limits.messages_per_minute`) and `limit_reached`
(`limits.messages_per_day`). Messages are never blocked for their content: the safety
patterns only add a notice for the receiver (13 section 5).

delete.summary:
Remove one of the caller's own text messages, within 15 minutes of sending (`invalid_state`
with `details.status = 'delete_window_passed'` after). The body is cleared; both members see
"Message removed". A message that is already removed is returned as it is.

post.summary:
Mark messages as read up to a message of this connection. The stored pointer never moves
backwards, and `unread_count` is recomputed from the data. `message.read` reaches the other
member only when both members send read receipts (09 section 9).

Propose the next stage: later than the current one (`invalid_state`), with no proposal
pending (`already_exists`), and not a stage this member proposed and saw declined in the
last 7 days (`cooldown_active`). Posts a `stage_proposed` system message and notifies the
other member.

delete.summary:
Withdraw the caller's own pending proposal. Posts a `stage_declined` system message with
`cancelled: true`.

post.summary:
Confirm the other member's proposal: the connection moves to its stage. Reaching
`nikah_done` closes both profiles (`found_match_here`), expires their pending interests and
ends their other connections (`found_someone_else`); the couple's chat stays readable.
Reaching `engaged` only makes the clients suggest pausing the profile.

Decline the other member's proposal. The stage stays; a `stage_declined` system message is
posted and nobody is notified. The proposer may suggest the same stage again after 7 days.
Record client-side product events as log lines (20 section 8.3). Always `204`.

get.summary: Everything the home screen needs in one call (15 section 10, 10 section 10).

Received or sent interests, newest first. `status` is `pending` (default), `accepted` or
`closed`. A sender sees a declined interest as "no response" under `pending` until it would
have expired, then under `closed`.

schema.description: `status` of `GET /v1/interests`. `closed` covers declined, withdrawn and expired.

post.summary: Send an interest.
post.description:
The checks of 15 section 11 run in order: the receiver must be `active` and openable
(`not_found`), not connected (`already_connected`), no pending interest from the caller
(`interest_already_pending`, also during a quiet decline), no cooldown (`cooldown_active`),
the receiver's `interest_permission` (`not_permitted_by_member`), the pending, connection and
daily limits (`limit_reached`), and the text rules on `message` (`validation_failed`).

When the receiver already has a pending interest to the caller, that interest is accepted
instead (mutual interest): checks 5, 6 and 8 are skipped, the message is ignored, and
`connection` is set in the answer.

post.summary:
Mark received interests as seen (once per id). Ids that are not the caller's received
interests are ignored.

get.summary: One interest the caller sent or received.

post.summary: Accept a received interest: only the receiver, only `pending`.
post.description:
The sender must still be openable (otherwise the interest expires and `invalid_state`), and
both members must be under `limits.active_connections_max` (`limit_reached` with
`details.side` `you` or `them`). Creates the connection, both member rows and the
`connected` system message in one transaction.

post.summary:
Decline a received interest: only the receiver, only `pending`. The sender is not told; they
see "No response yet" until the interest would have expired. With `also_block`, the sender
is also blocked (15 section 13).

Withdraw a sent interest: only the sender, only `pending`. The receiver is not told; their
notification for it is removed. An interest that was quietly declined answers as withdrawn
too, so the decline never shows (11 section 3.5 rule 2).

get.summary:
Session bootstrap: user, profile summary, gate, counters. Never fails with a gate error;
creates the account rows on the first call (06 section 5).

post.summary: Accept new versions of legal documents.

Schedules the deletion of the account. The profile is hidden at once and purged after
`account.deletion_grace_days`. A banned or suspended account keeps its status.

delete.summary:
Cancels a scheduled deletion. The account is `active` again; a banned or suspended account
keeps that status and only the deletion is cancelled.

post.summary:
Registers a push token. The token is unique: one already registered to another user moves
to the caller (14 section 4.4).

delete.summary:
Removes the caller's registration of a push token, on sign-out. Answers `204` also when the
token is not registered, so that signing out never fails.

post.summary: Requests a download of the member's data. At most one request per 24 hours.

get.summary: Status and download link of the latest export.

The identity document summary, or `null` while no number was registered. The number is
never returned.

put.summary: Register or replace the identity document number.
put.description:
Rules of 12 section 3: the number is normalised and checked against the document type and
the profile's gender, hashed with the pepper and compared with `banned_identities` and the
other profiles, then stored encrypted with the profile id as associated data. A `pending`
or `verified` identity cannot be changed (`invalid_state`); a `rejected` one is replaced and
goes back to `unverified`.

get.summary: The caller's notification settings (14 section 6.1).

put.summary:
Replaces the notification settings. Every switch is required; the quiet hours are both set
or both `null` (14 section 6.2).

post.summary: Finish onboarding.
post.description:
Requires `onboarding_step = review`. Re-validates every required field and the 18+ rule,
then sets the status to `active`, or to `pending_review` when `moderation.profile_review` is
`manual` or a system report about the profile is open (13 section 2.3). Enqueues the first
recommendations refresh and, for a profile that goes live, the `welcome` email. Returns `Me`.

post.summary: Mark the current onboarding step as done.
post.description:
`step` must equal the current `onboarding_step` and must not be `review` or `done`. The
step's requirement (03 section 4.3) is checked against the saved profile; on failure the
answer is `validation_failed` naming the missing fields. Returns `Me`.

get.summary:
Requests received or sent, newest first. `box=received` (default) lists the requests for the
caller's photos and, with `status=granted`, the access the caller gave; `box=sent` lists the
caller's own requests. `status` defaults to `pending`.
get.description:
A member is never told that a request was denied or that access was removed (09 sections
6.3 and 6.4), so `box=sent` lists only `pending` and `granted` rows: with `status=denied` or
`status=revoked` it answers an empty page.

schema.description: Which side of the requests a list shows.

put.summary:
Let a member see the caller's photos without a request. Allowed from no row, `denied`,
`revoked` and `pending` (which approves the request), and only when the caller may open the
target (`404` otherwise; for a `paused` caller that means members they are related to).
Granting twice changes nothing and answers `204`. The target receives
`photo_request_granted`.

parameters.name: profile_id
parameters.description: The member to give access to

delete.summary:
Take access back: `granted` to `revoked`. The viewer is not told; the photos are blurred
again on their next request, and they may ask again after `photo_access.retry_days`. `404`
when the caller has no row for the member, `409 invalid_state` when the row is not
`granted`.

parameters.name: profile_id
parameters.description: The member whose access is removed

post.summary:
Deny a request: `pending` to `denied`. The requester is not told, and may ask again after
`photo_access.retry_days`. Any other state answers `409 invalid_state`; a request that is
not the caller's answers `404`.

Approve a request: `pending` to `granted`. Any other state answers `409 invalid_state`
with the current `status`; a request that is not the caller's answers `404`. The requester
receives `photo_request_granted`.

get.summary:
The caller's photos in display order, every status, with signed URLs for the clear
variants (`null` while processing and after a failure).

post.summary: Confirms an upload and starts processing.
post.description:
The key must be one this profile was given (anything else is `404`), and the object must
exist and be at most 10 MiB (`404` and `413`; an oversized object is deleted). Confirming
the same key again returns the existing photo with `200`; a new photo is `201` with status
`processing` and a `process_photo` job.

put.summary:
Sets the display order. The list must name every photo of the profile once; otherwise
`validation_failed` on `photo_ids`. Does not change which photo is primary.

post.summary: Asks for an upload URL. The key is `tmp/photos/{profile_id}/{uuid}`.
post.description:
Answers `payload_too_large` over 10 MiB, `limit_reached` when the profile already holds
`limits.photos_max` photos that are not `rejected` or `failed`, and `503` when storage is
not available.

delete.summary:
Deletes a photo. The R2 objects go through a `delete_objects` job. Deleting the primary
hands it to the approved photo with the lowest position; a profile left without an approved
photo loses `has_approved_photo`; a new primary clears `is_photo_verified`.

patch.summary:
Makes an approved photo the primary one (03 section 4.4). A different primary clears
`is_photo_verified`, because the badge vouches for the face others see first (12 section 4.6).
Choosing the photo that is already primary changes nothing. Returns every photo.

get.summary:
The partner preferences: the stored row, or the computed defaults (07 section 12) until the
first `PUT`.

put.summary:
Replace the partner preferences. Creates the row when it is missing, validates codes, ranges
and array sizes, sets `match_stale`, and holds a changed `notes` text for review (13 section
3.7). Returns what was stored.

get.summary: The privacy settings (09 section 3).

patch.summary:
Change some privacy settings. Takes effect immediately for every viewer. Changing the
visibility of caste, income or family marks the recommendations stale (10 section 8.2).
Returns the full settings.

get.summary:
The owner's complete view of the profile: every section, `missing`, `locked_fields`, the
photos, the identity summary, the verification state and the status of the moderated texts.

post.summary: Close the profile: `active` or `paused` to `closed`.
post.description:
Every pending interest sent or received by the profile expires (03 section 4.2); the
connections stay and become read-only.

post.summary: Hide the profile from discovery: `active` to `paused`.
post.description:
Pending interests stay and can still be answered (03 section 4.2). `invalid_state` from any
other status.

get.summary:
The caller's own profile as another member would see it, at the tier `as` (15 section 7,
08 section 4). Works in every profile status and records no view.

post.summary: Open a closed profile again: `closed` to `active`.
post.description:
`confirm` must be `true`. When the profile was closed after a confirmed nikah, reopening
ends that connection with the reason `other` (03 section 4.2); the clients ask the member to
type a confirmation first.

post.summary: Send a `changes_requested` profile back to review.
post.description:
Requires `status = changes_requested` (`invalid_state` otherwise). Re-validates every
required field as `complete` does, sets the status to `pending_review` and clears
`status_reason`. Returns `Me`.

post.summary: Go live again: `paused` to `active`. The recommendations are marked stale (10 section 8.2).

put.summary: Replace one section of the profile.
put.description:
`{section}` is one of `account_for`, `basics`, `community`, `location`, `education_career`,
`family`, `lifestyle` and `contacts`. The body is the matching section type of `OwnProfile`;
a key sent as `null` clears the value. While the profile is a `draft`, required fields may
be `null`; afterwards they can no longer be cleared. Fields in `locked_fields` must be sent
with their current value. Recomputes `completeness`, marks the recommendations stale (not
for `contacts`) and holds a changed free text for review. Returns the updated `OwnProfile`.

schema.description: The eight sections of 15 section 7, as they appear in the path.

get.summary: The caller's saved searches, newest first.

post.summary: Save a search. At most `limits.saved_searches_max` (10) per profile (`limit_reached`).

patch.summary: Rename a saved search or switch its notifications.

get.summary: The state of the caller's checks and their latest requests.

post.summary: Submits a verification request.
post.description:
Field errors: `gesture` must be today's or yesterday's challenge (`mismatch`); every key must
be one of the caller's uploads that exists (`invalid`); `back_key` is required for `cnic`,
`nicop` and `poc` (`required`). `already_exists` when a request of the kind is pending,
`invalid_state` when an identity check has no identity number to check or a selfie has no
approved photo to compare with, `profile_not_active` when the profile is `closed`.

get.summary:
The gesture to perform in today's selfie, derived from the profile id and the date in
`Asia/Karachi` (12 section 4.2).

post.summary:
A presigned `PUT` for one verification image. The key is `verification/{profile_id}/{uuid}`.
A profile that is `closed` cannot verify (03 section 5).

delete.summary:
Cancels a pending request. An identity check goes back to `unverified`, and the images are
deleted by the next `purge_verification_media` run (12 section 5.4).

get.summary:
The caller's own viewing history for the last 30 days (09 section 8.2 rule 4). Profiles the
caller can no longer open are left out.

Who viewed the caller's profile in the last 30 days, without private visits and without
viewers the caller can no longer open (09 section 8.3). Empty with
`hidden_because_private` when the caller browses privately (09 section 8.2).
Name, version and environment of the running API.
The latest Android release, for the in-app update prompt.

The notification feed, newest first. Rows whose actor the caller can no longer open are
left out (14 section 7.3 rule 3).

post.summary:
Marks notifications as read: `{ "ids": [...] }` or `{ "all": true }`. Ids that are not the
caller's are ignored. The `counters` event goes to the caller's sockets.

put.summary:
Mark a profile as not interested for `pass.duration_days` (180): it leaves the caller's
recommendations and search, and any shortlist entry is removed. A pending sent interest
is not withdrawn (11 section 12).

get.summary: Resolves a profile code to an id, under the same visibility rules (09 section 4.3 rule 8).

parameters.name: public_code
parameters.description: A profile code such as KR7F3K2QX9

get.summary:
Another member's profile. `404` whenever the caller may not open it (09 section 2). Records
a profile view and counts it against `limits.profile_views_per_day`, except for connections
(09 section 8.1).

post.summary: Ask to see a member's photos. The checks run in the order of 09 section 6.3:
post.description:
1. The caller is `active` (access level `browse`) and may open the owner (`404` otherwise).
2. The caller currently gets blurred photos and the owner has an approved photo, otherwise
   `409 invalid_state` with `details.status = "visible"`.
3. The owner accepts requests, otherwise `409 not_permitted_by_member` with
   `details.reason = "requests_off"`.
4. No request is pending (`409 already_exists`).
5. A denial or revocation is older than `photo_access.retry_days`
   (`409 cooldown_active` with `retry_after_date`).
6. Fewer than `limits.photo_requests_per_day` requests were sent today
   (`429 limit_reached`).

The owner receives a `photo_request_received` notification and a `counters` event.

get.summary:
Ranked matches, paginated. A stale list is refreshed first when that takes under 2
seconds; otherwise the old list is served with `is_refreshing: true` (10 section 8.6).
Each returned candidate's `shown_count` grows, at most once every 6 hours.

post.summary:
Recompute recommendations now: marks them stale and enqueues the refresh job. At most once
per 10 minutes (`rate_limited`).

get.summary: All small lookup lists and option labels. Supports `ETag` / `If-None-Match`.

City search. Without `q`: major cities first, then by population. With `q`: names that start
with it first, then by similarity (15 section 5).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: At least 2 characters; prefix and trigram match.

get.summary: Regions of a country, sorted by name.

post.summary:
Report a member, a photo or a message. The caller must be able to see the subject, else
`404 not_found` (13 section 6.1): the target through the visibility rules for a profile or
a photo (an `approved` photo of the target), a connection the caller belongs to for a
message (one the target sent; an ended connection counts).
post.description:
The context is captured at filing time (13 section 6.3): the profile text fields, the photo
keys, or for a message the 20 messages before it, the message and the 5 after it from that
connection only. At most `limits.reports_per_day` reports a day (`429 limit_reached`); a
report on a subject the caller already has an `open` or `in_review` report on returns that
report's id and creates nothing. With `also_block` the block is applied in the same
transaction, also for that repeated report. Answers `201` with the report id. The reported
member is not told and nothing changes for them.

post.summary: Search with filters (10 section 9). The stored preferences are not applied; E1 to E9 are.

get.summary: Shortlisted profiles, newest first.

put.summary:
Add a profile to the shortlist, or replace its note. At most 200 entries (`limit_reached`).
The other member is never told.

delete.summary: Remove a profile from the shortlist. Works even when the profile is no longer visible.

get.summary:
Opens the realtime socket. An `Origin` header, when present, must be an allowed web origin
(Android sends none). Then send `{"type":"auth","token":"<Clerk token>"}` within 10 seconds.

post.summary: Clerk user events. `204` on success and on duplicates; `400` on a bad signature.

AccountForBody.description:
The body of `PUT .../sections/account_for`: the section plus the consents ticked on the
screen, recorded at their current versions (07 section 3.4 rule 3).

manager_name.description: Never shown to other members. Always `null` when `managed_by` is `self`.

AdminCaste.description: A caste or sub-caste, active or not.

AdminOtherPhoto.description: Another photo of the same profile, shown beside the one under review.

AdminPhotoItem.description: A photo in the review queue (18 section 4.2).

would_be_primary.description: The profile has no approved photo yet, so approving this one makes it the main photo.

AdminProfile.description:
`GET /v1/admin/profiles/{profile_id}`.

`profile`, `preferences` and `privacy` carry the objects of 15 sections 4.3 and 4.5 exactly
(`OwnProfile`, `Preferences`, `Privacy`); the unblurred photo URLs and, for admins, the
contact details are included.

audit.description: Newest 20 entries whose target is this profile or its user.

preferences.description: `Preferences` (15 section 4.5), `null` when the profile has none.

privacy.description: `Privacy` (15 section 4.5). `null` only after the account was purged.

AdminProfileListItem.description: A row of the profile search and review queue.

photo_thumb_url.description: First photo of any status, unblurred.

money_flags_30d.description: Messages with `safety_flag = 'money'` sent in the last 30 days.

context.description: The snapshot taken at filing time (13 section 6.3 and 5.5).

related_reports.description: Other `open` or `in_review` reports on the same target.

AdminReportListItem.description: A row of the report queue.

open_reports_on_target.description: Reports on the same target that are `open` or `in_review`.

AdminSanction.description: A row of `sanctions` with the staff emails resolved.

AdminTextItem.description: A text waiting for a person (18 section 4.3).

text_sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of `text`. Send it back with the decision.

audit.description: Newest 50 entries whose target is this user or their profile.

AdminUserListItem.description: A row of the user search.

gesture_valid.description: The gesture equals the challenge of the submission day or the day before.

AdminVerificationIdentity.description: The registered identity of an `id_document` request.

number.description: Decrypted, formatted `#####-#######-#` for the 13-digit document types.

AdminVerificationImages.description:
Signed image URLs, valid for 10 minutes. `null` when the slot was not used or the image has
been purged.

AdminVerificationListItem.description: A request in the queue (18 section 4.4).

AdminVerificationProfile.description: The profile data to compare with the documents.

photos.description: The approved photos, for comparison with the selfie.

recipients_estimate.description: Users who are `active` with an `active` or `paused` profile.

text_ur.description: Up to 300 characters, shown to members who use Urdu.

text_sha256.description: The hash of the text the moderator read.

photos_match.description:
On an `id_document` request: the moderator confirmed that the selfie matches the profile
photos, which also earns the photo badge (12 section 5.4).

details.description: Never holds an identity number, a contact detail or private message text.

reason.description: Shown to the member. 3 to 500 characters.

date_of_birth.description:
`YYYY-MM-DD`. A string in the request so that an impossible date is a field error
(`invalid`) and not a malformed body.

BlockItem.description: One blocked profile: only the name at tier `member` and the code (15 section 13).

can_send_interest.description: The same result as `Relation.can_send_interest`, so lists can offer "Send interest".

similar.description: Existing castes whose name or alias has a trigram similarity of 0.4 or more.

CityRef.description: A city with its region, as every response shows it.

language_codes.description: Languages besides the mother tongue, at most 6.

Compatibility.description: The compatibility block of the profile screen (15 section 4.6 `Compatibility`).

dimensions.description: One entry per dimension set in the viewer's preferences, in the fixed order.

owner_fit.description: 0..100: how well the viewer fits the owner's preferences.

viewer_fit.description: 0..100: how well the owner fits the viewer's preferences.

score.description: 0..1: how well the owner satisfies the viewer on it.

CompletenessItem.description:
Completeness items of 08 section 6.1, in table order. The code is the key sent in
`OwnProfile.missing`.

Connection.description: A connection as one of its members sees it (15 section 4.7).

oneOf.description: Returned only to the member who ended it; `null` for the other member.

`null`: the other account is deleted, scheduled for deletion, suspended or banned, or
the profile can no longer be opened; the client shows "Member no longer available".

their_last_read_message_id.description: `null` unless both members have `send_read_receipts` on (09 section 9).

ConnectionPage.description: A page of connections, latest activity first.

ContactShare.description: The caller's own contact share on a connection (15 section 4.7).

ContactsSection.description: Private contact details (08 section 3). Never part of another member's response.

step.description: Must equal the current `onboarding_step`, and must not be `review` or `done`.

pending_interests.description: Received pending interests whose sender can still be opened.

unread_chats.description: Active, unmuted connections with unread messages.

parent_code.description: A top-level caste: makes this a sub-caste (two levels only).

min_supported_version_code.description:
Not greater than `version_code`, not lower than the current minimum. Builds below it
are forced to update (`426 upgrade_required`).

release_notes.description: Up to 1,000 characters, shown in the update prompt.

version_code.description: Must be greater than every existing `version_code`.

reason.description: Optional, up to 300 characters. Only logged, never stored.

DetailFamily.description:
`ProfileDetail.family`: the fields of group `family`, except `about_family`, and the home
fields of group `home`. A hidden group's fields are `null`.

DetailLifestyle.description:
`ProfileDetail.lifestyle`: the lifestyle section without the appearance fields and
`about_me`. The health fields belong to group `health`.

origin_label.description: The family's home town: a city name or the owner's typed value.

DisplayStatus.description:
`Interest.display_status` (15 section 4.7): what the client shows. Declines are hidden from
senders.

also_block.description: Also block the other member (15 section 13).

code.description: Stable code clients branch on (15 section 2.1).

message.description: English text suitable for display as a fallback.

home_size_value.description: Greater than 0, at most 99,999.99, at most two decimal places.

FieldError.description: One invalid field of a request body.

field.description: JSON key of the request body, dot-separated for nested keys.

also_block.description: Block the target in the same transaction. Default `false`.

details.description:
Optional, at most 1,000 characters. Length is the only rule: a report may need to quote
a phone number or abusive words (13 section 3.1, "Not checked").

message_id.description:
Required for `message`, not allowed otherwise: a message the target sent in a
connection the caller belongs to.

photo_id.description: Required for `photo`, not allowed otherwise: an approved photo of the target.

nearby.description: Up to 10, same city, then same region.

new_members.description: Up to 10, joined in the last 7 days, passing the must-haves in both directions.

IdentityBody.description:
A request that carries an identity number. The number is kept out of `Debug` output and
zeroed on drop (12 section 2.3), and a body of the wrong type is refused without echoing the
value.

IdentitySummary.description: An identity document the owner registered. The number is never returned (12 section 2.3).

Interest.description: An interest as one of its two members sees it (15 section 4.7).

compat_score.description: The compatibility of the pair when the interest was sent (0..100).

connection_id.description: The connection created when the interest was accepted.

oneOf.description: The other profile; `null` when it is no longer visible to the caller (09 section 2).

responded_at.description: `null` for the sender of a declined interest, which must still look unanswered.

seen.description:
The receiver always sees their own state; the sender sees `true` only when both members
send read receipts (09 section 9).

status.description:
For the sender a `declined` interest is reported as `pending` until `expires_at`, then as
`expired`: the real value never reaches the sender.

InterestDirection.description:
Direction of an interest seen from the viewer: `sent` by the viewer to the owner, or
`received` by the viewer from the owner (15 section 4.6 `interest_direction`).

InterestPage.description: A page of interests, newest first.

Items_AdminCaste.description: A list that is returned whole instead of paged (`GET /castes`, `/settings`, `/releases`).

items.description: A caste or sub-caste, active or not.

Items_AdminRelease.description: A list that is returned whole instead of paged (`GET /castes`, `/settings`, `/releases`).

Items_SettingItem.description: A list that is returned whole instead of paged (`GET /castes`, `/settings`, `/releases`).

LastActive.description: Last active label (03 section 6). Never an exact time.

LatestExport.description: The status of the latest export, with a download link once it is ready.

download_url.description: A signed link, only while `status` is `ready`.

region_id.description: Overwritten with the region of `city_id` when a listed city is chosen.

date_of_birth.description: `YYYY-MM-DD`. The candidate must be 18 or older today.

LockedGroup.description: Groups of fields that privacy settings can hide (09 section 5).

LookingFor.description:
What the owner is looking for, as display lines, each marked with whether the viewer fits
(15 section 4.6 `LookingFor`).

dimension.description: Dimension key from 10 section 4, for example `age`.

importance.description: The owner's importance for the dimension.

summary_values.description: Codes or formatted values, for example `["25", "32"]` for an age range (10 section 11.1).

viewer_matches.description:
`true` when the viewer scores 1 on it, `null` when the viewer's value is unknown,
otherwise `false`.

deletion_grace_days.description: `account.deletion_grace_days`, for the text of the delete dialog.

interests_per_day.description: The daily limit that applies to this profile.

MemberEndReason.description:
The reasons a member may give for ending a connection (15 section 12). `blocked` and
`account_closed` are set only by the system.

Message.description: A chat message as one member sees it (15 section 4.7).

body.description: `null` when deleted, and for system messages.

client_message_id.description: The sender's idempotency key; set only on the caller's own messages.

oneOf.description: Only on messages from `them` (13 section 5.1 rule 3).

MessagesPage.description: One page of the message history.

has_more.description: More messages exist in the same direction.

environment.description: Deployment the API runs in: `local`, `staging` or `production`.

ModeratedField.description: The three moderated free-text fields (13 section 3.7).

Notification.description: One row of the feed, also the body of the `notification.new` event (15 section 14).

NotificationActor.description: Who caused a notification, rendered for the recipient (09 section 4, 14 section 3).

display_name.description: Reduced according to the actor's `name_display` and the relation (09 section 4.1).

NotificationPreferences.description: `notification_preferences` without the key and timestamps (15 section 6).

quiet_hours_start.description: Local time in `users.timezone`, `HH:MM`. Both quiet hours are set or both are `null`.

NudgeCode.description: A nudge code (10 section 10.1). [`NudgeCode::ALL`] is in priority order, highest first.

OldestWaiting.description: Created time of the longest-waiting item of each queue, `null` when the queue is empty.

photo_ids.description: Every photo of the profile exactly once, in the new order.

active_last_7d.description: Active profiles with `last_active_at` in the last 7 days.

jobs_dead.description: Above zero means a background job failed permanently and needs a developer.

photos_flagged.description: Subset of `photos_pending` whose automatic result is `flag`.

OwnLocation.description: `LocationSection` with the two cities resolved, as `OwnProfile.location` shows it.

thumb_url.description: `null` while processing or after a failure.

OwnProfile.description: The owner's complete view of the profile (15 section 4.3).

locked_fields.description: Fields the owner can no longer edit (03 section 8 rule 15).

missing.description: Completeness items not yet met, most valuable first (08 section 6.2).

OwnVerification.description: Verification flags and the requests still waiting for a moderator.

items.description: A photo in the review queue (18 section 4.2).

would_be_primary.description: The profile has no approved photo yet, so approving this one makes it the main photo.

items.description: A row of the profile search and review queue.

photo_thumb_url.description: First photo of any status, unblurred.

items.description: A row of the report queue.

open_reports_on_target.description: Reports on the same target that are `open` or `in_review`.

items.description: A text waiting for a person (18 section 4.3).

text_sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of `text`. Send it back with the decision.

items.description: A row of the user search.
A request in the queue (18 section 4.4).

details.description: Never holds an identity number, a contact detail or private message text.

similar.description: Existing castes whose name or alias has a trigram similarity of 0.4 or more.

items.description: One row of the feed, also the body of the `notification.new` event (15 section 14).

oneOf.description: `null` when the other profile can no longer be opened.

profile_id.description:
The other profile: the requester in `received`, the owner in `sent`. Present even when
`profile` is `null`, so a grant can still be revoked.

Party.description: Which member did something, seen from the caller.

is_active.description: Deactivating a caste that has active sub-castes is refused.

name_ur.description: An empty string removes the Urdu name.

timezone.description: An IANA time zone name such as `Asia/Karachi`.

is_primary.description: Only `true` is accepted: a photo stops being primary when another one becomes it.

PendingStageProposal.description: The pending stage proposal of a connection.

oneOf.description: `null` when the other profile can no longer be opened.

profile_id.description:
The other profile: the requester in `received`, the owner in `sent`. Present even when
`profile` is `null`, so a grant can still be revoked.

PhotoRequested.description: The answer to a photo request: always `pending`.

PhotoView.description:
Another member's photo as the viewer may see it (15 section 4.4). In blurred mode the URLs
point at the separate blurred files and `large_url` is `null` (09 section 6.2).

Preferences.description:
Every column of `partner_preferences` except `profile_id`, `notes_status` and the timestamps.
An empty array or a `null` bound means "no preference" for that dimension.

beard_types.description: Used when the candidate seeks a man.

hijab_types.description: Used when the candidate seeks a woman.

notes.description: "What I am looking for", shown on the profile once approved (13 section 3).

PreferencesBody.description: Body of `PUT /v1/me/notification-preferences`: the complete object (16 section 6.26).

Privacy.description: Every column of `profile_privacy` except `profile_id` and the timestamps.

area_visibility.description: Neighbourhood; the city is always visible.

PrivacyPatch.description: The body of `PATCH /v1/me/privacy`: any subset of `Privacy` (15 section 7).

ProfileCard.description: The compact form of another member's profile, used in every list (15 section 4.6).

caste_label.description: The caste name or the owner's typed value; `null` when hidden or not stated.

display_name.description: Already reduced according to the owner's `name_display` (09 section 4).

oneOf.description: `null` unless both members show when they were last active (09 section 9).
The primary photo; `null` when the profile has no approved photo.

ProfileDetail.description:
The full form of another member's profile (15 section 4.6). A hidden value is `null`; the
groups listed in `locked` are those that connecting would reveal (09 section 5.5).

oneOf.description: `null` only in the owner's own preview (15 section 7).

code.description:
Lower case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. A sub-caste's code
starts with `<parent_code>_`.

parent_code.description: Must be the suggestion's own parent, when it has one.

PromotedCaste.description: The result of promoting a caste suggestion.

profiles_updated.description: Profiles whose typed caste was replaced by the new code.

ProposableStage.description: The stages a member may propose.

value.description: The new value; its type depends on the key (18 section 7.1).

is_refreshing.description: The list was stale and is still being recomputed in the background.

ReferenceBootstrap.description: Everything a client needs to render pickers.

options.description: One entry per closed list, keyed by list name (05 section 2).

version.description: Changes whenever any list changes; equals the `ETag`.

note.description: Shown to the member, at most 300 characters.

text_sha256.description: The hash of the text the moderator read.

note.description: Staff only, never shown to the member.

Relation.description: What links the viewer to the owner, and what the viewer may do next (15 section 4.6).

can_send_interest_after.description: The date the cooldown ends, for `cooldown` (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

RelationInterest.description: `Relation.interest`: the pending interest between the two members.

RelaxationHint.description:
Which must-have to loosen, and how many more profiles that would show (15 section 10,
`relaxation_hints`).

ReleasePlatform.description: The platforms a release can be for.

ReportPhoto.description: The reported photo of a `photo` report.

large_url.description: Signed, unblurred. `null` when the object is gone.

ReporterSummary.description: How many reports a reporter filed and how they were decided (`reporter_summary`).

reason.description: Shown to the member on the fix-your-profile screen. 10 to 500 characters.

SavedSearchesPage.description: `GET /v1/me/saved-searches`: at most 10 entries, so always one page.

SearchFilters.description:
Search filters (15 section 4.8). Keys match `Preferences`. A missing key, `null` or an
empty array means no filter.

public_code.description: Exact profile code; when set, every other filter is ignored.

total_estimate.description: Exact up to 500, `null` above; computed on the first page only.

SearchSort.description: The order of search results (10 section 9.3).

SectionBody.description:
Documentation only: the body of `PUT .../sections/{section}` is the section type named in
the path. The handler picks the type itself, so that a body that does not fit its section
is reported as such.

interest_ids.description: Ids of received interests that were rendered on screen; at most 100.

message.description: At most 300 characters; the text rules apply (13 section 3).

client_message_id.description: A UUID made by the client for each new message and reused on every retry.

SentInterest.description: The answer of `POST /v1/interests`: `connection` is set when a mutual interest created one.

SharedContact.description:
The other member's contact details shared with the caller: only the selected items, the
others `null` (09 section 10.2 rule 4).

SharedGuardian.description: The guardian item of a shared contact.

note.description: A private note, at most 300 characters. `null` or missing clears it.

ShortlistItem.description:
One shortlist entry. `profile` is `null` when the profile is no longer visible; the client
shows "No longer available" with a remove button.

SubmitVerification.description: `POST /v1/me/verifications` (15 section 9): an identity check or a photo check.

reason.description: Shown to the member. 3 to 500 characters.

TextStatuses.description: The status of each moderated text (03 section 4.5).

Tier.description: Relation tier of a viewer to an owner (03 section 6), evaluated in this order.

size_bytes.description: The size of the file in bytes, at most 10 MiB.

UploadSlot.description: Which image of a request an upload is for (15 section 9).

UploadTicket.description: Where and how to `PUT` a file (15 section 8).

headers.description: Exactly these headers must be sent with the `PUT`.

upload_key.description: The key to send back when confirming.

upload_url.description: A presigned `PUT` URL, valid for 10 minutes.

money_flags_30d.description: Messages with `safety_flag = 'money'` sent in the last 30 days.

reporter_misuse.description: 5 or more dismissed reports and none actioned in 30 days (13 section 6.6).

shared_device_with_sanctioned_user.description: A system report records that the user signed in on a device of a sanctioned account.

VerificationRequestSummary.description: One verification request as its owner sees it. The reviewer's note stays with staff.

size_bytes.description: The size of the file in bytes, at most 10 MiB.

VisitorItem.description: One visitor or one visited profile (15 section 10).

hidden_because_private.description: True when the caller browses privately and therefore sees no visitors (09 section 8.2).

reason.description: Shown to the member. 3 to 500 characters.
